description: Save your upcoming Canvas deadlines as an .ics calendar file you can import into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook, with a reminder before each one. Nothing changes in Canvas.

days.description: How many days ahead to include. Default 60.

include_completed.description: If true, also include work you have already submitted.

include_events.description: If true, also include calendar events such as class meetings, not just deadlines.

remind_minutes_before.description: Reminder this many minutes before each deadline. Default 1440 (one day). 0 for no reminder.

name: export_deadlines_ics
title: Export Deadlines Ics
